Name: Not Human
Author: deimonns
Description:
[b]What it does[/b]

I've spoiled myself by looking for every instance of the word 'human' in the game strings and replacing them for your roleplaying convenience. You're welcome.

In all seriousness, this mod replaces various mentions and allegations of the farmer being human by either:

[list]
[*] Referring to the player's configured species, or
[*] Referring to the player as a non-human, or
[*] Making the dialogue species-neutral when it fits best
[/list]
It goes without saying that this mod assumes the player's character [b]won't be[/b] human. To play as a human, remove the mod (I might add a "Mod Enabled" toggle eventually).

I made this cause I keep making weird characters with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10324]FS Animals and Myths Pack[/url] (can't help it) and it was a little immersion-breaking to see characters refer to a 9-tailed foxgirl as a human.

The dialogue should work regardless of your "species" choice; its been written in a way that's agnostic but recognizes your input at the same time. The only exceptions to this are trying to roleplay as a dwarf or a shadow person; Dwarf and Krobus' dialogues won't make much sense then. I've no plans to accomodate for this.

Elves are also an important lore point in SVE and supposed to be extinct; I provide an option to retcon this but I don't know if I caught everything (there's a lot of content in SVE!).

[b]How to use[/b]

Install the mod by dropping it into your Mods folder, then use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure your species as desired. You can hover over any of the settings for more detailed explanations.

Alternatively you can manually modify the [b]config.json[/b] if you know how, but you'll miss on the hover information.

[b]Compatibility[/b]

[b]Existing saves[/b]

Should work just fine -  mod only changes dialogue.

[b]Multiplayer[/b]

I didn't test it but I would assume it is compatible, each player just has to configure the mod separetely for their character.

[b]Other mods[/b]

Has built-in compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]. Its automatically enabled when its installed.

Should be mostly compatible with everything else, but note that if other mods treat the farmer as a human there's nothing this one can do about it.

The following mods are known to be compatible:

[list]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/722]Gender Neutrality Mod[/url] (last checked 4.1.0)
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7107]Not a Farmer[/url] (last checked 1.3.2)
[/list]
